configs.name: IxFlow | Server Countries by Bytes

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by ixServerIpCountryName as ixServerIpCountryName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 10

configs.name: IxFlow | Client Endpoints

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication), ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp), ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime) by clientIp as clientIp, ixClientIpCountryName as ixClientIpCountryName, ixClientAsName as ixClientAsName, ixOsDeviceName as ixOsDeviceName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb), ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

configs.name: IxFlow | Server Endpoints

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp), ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime), ixMaxTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=max(ixTcpAppResponseTime) by serverIp as serverIp, serverPort as serverPort, ixApplication as ixApplication, ixServerIpCountryName as ixServerIpCountryName, ixServerIpCityName as ixServerIpCityName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb), ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000), ixMaxTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixMaxTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

configs.description: Server IP / port / application with geolocation, volume, clients and latency.

queries.nql: ixDnsQueryHostname != null AND ixDnsQueryHostname != "" | aggr ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp), ixLastSeen=max(timestamp) by ixDnsQueryHostname as ixDnsQueryHostname, ixDnsClass as ixDnsClass unwind=true | sort ixFlows desc | limit 500
